findings.question: q-chemistry-atomic-structure-0018
findings.quote: An orbital describes an electron’s quantum state and its associated probability distribution. It is not a fixed classical path.
findings.problem: “Quantum state,” “associated probability distribution,” and “classical path” are unexplained technical terms. A Grade 5 reader cannot learn what an orbital means from this explanation; the lesson gives the simpler idea of a region where an electron is likely to be found.
findings.fix: Use plain English: An orbital tells us where an electron is likely to be found around the nucleus.
